Akhilesh Yadav Celebrates 53rd Birthday with Party and Greetings from Leaders

Uttar Pradesh's former Chief Minister and Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Akhilesh Yadav celebrated his 53rd birthday on January 1st, with party workers organizing a grand celebration in Varanasi. The occasion saw leaders from various parties extending birthday greetings to him.
